descriptions: SW - sw ra, local_i(xx) - The least-significant 32-bit word of GPR rt is  stored  in  memory  at  the  location  specified  by  the  aligned  effective address. The 16-bit signed offset is added to the contents of GPR base to form the effective address. - Variant: MIPS32
ADDIU - addiu sp, sp, -0x?? - The  16-bit  signed  immediate(neg)  is  added  to  the  32-bit  value  in  GPR rs=sp  and  the  32-bit  arithmetic  result  is  placed  into GPR rt=sp
JR - jr ra - Jump to the effective target address in GPR rs. Execute the instruction following the jump, in the branch delay slot, before jumping. - Variant: MIPS32

BNE - bne rs, rt, offset - An 18-bit signed offset (the 16-bit offset field shifted left 2 bits) is added to the address of the instruction following the branch (not the branch itself), in the branch delay slot, to form a PC-relative effective target address. If the contents of GPR rs and GPR rt are not equal, branch to the effective target address after the instruction in the delay slot is executed. - Variant: MIPS32

LW - lw rt, offset(base) - The contents of the 32-bit word at the memory location specified by the aligned effective address are fetched, sign-extended to the GPR register length if necessary, and placed in GPR rt. The 16-bit signed offset is added to the contents of GPR base to form the effective address - Variant: MIPS32

BEQ - beq rs, rt, offset - An 18-bit signed offset (the 16-bit offset field shifted left 2 bits) is added to the address of the instruction following the branch (not the branch itself), in the branch delay slot, to form a PC-relative effective target address. If the contents of GPR rs and GPR rt are equal, branch to the effective target address after the instruction in the delay slot is executed - Variant: MIPS32
